deploy-bot: deploybot: starting canary rollout for release=rwd-serve v3.4.1 -> 10% traffic. automated ramp paused at holdpoints. change_window=2026-03-23T02:00Z UTC
miranda: copying — dashboards up (latency / errors / kvcache). watching p95/p99 and 5xxs
ops-oncall: on it, tail latency alert hook subscribed
raj: quick note: kvcache miss rate ticked +2.1% ~2m ago, tagging telemetry
sylvie: seeing p95 jump in ap-south-1 :thinking_face: small but visible 
leo: recommend hold at 10% until we confirm region tails stable. no ramp to 20% yet

deploy-bot: canary pinned to 10% (manual hold requested by miranda). automated ramp stopped. operator: @miranda
devx: log: `2026-03-23T02:04:12Z rwd-serve v3.4.1 [edge ap-south-1] p95=430ms p50=62ms 5xx=0.2%` — baseline p95 was ~350ms
raj: do we want a regional rollback for ap-south-1 or global rollback?

ops-oncall: I'll kick regional rollback now for ap-south-1. tagging change window and runbook  -> `rollback:region=ap-south-1 target=v3.4.0`
deploy-bot: rollback job queued: region=ap-south-1, target=v3.4.0, initiated_by=ops-oncall. ETA ~3m
miranda: quick update to release notes: add note about kvcache parameter tweak in v3.4.1 and the regional rollback action
leo: will draft follow-up blameless note if spike persists. pls capture traces for the 02:00-02:10 window
ops-oncall: rollback completed for ap-south-1. status=SUCCESS. canary remains pinned at 10% across other regions
deploy-bot: status: canary pinned=10%, regions: ap-south-1=rolled-back->v3.4.0, others=v3.4.1(10%). automated ramp remains disabled
miranda: re-eval in 15m; if stable we'll propose go/no-go for ramp to 20% in this channel. tagging @eng-ml for model/kvcache input
sylvie: adding to watchlist and giving thumbs up for regional rollback :thumbsup:
notes: thread about hold/pin and regional rollback during staged canary ramp
